implementation: optional dependency-free Node ./realtime export; Rust byte foundation unchanged
negotiation: explicit peer capabilities supplied by the caller before binding; same wire version, class intersection and minimum resource bounds; not authentication

envelope.payload: canonical base64 of opaque bytes, length checked after bounded framing; decoded callback receives Buffer
envelope.sequence: existing LogicalSession checked u64 MessageSequence, decimal string on wire; local DeliveryReceipt carries the same sequence

STATE.rule: Snapshot or owner-produced Delta; peer ACK advances only confirmed delivery cursor; never canonical adoption

COMMAND.rule: opaque application OperationId; peer ACK is not admission; correlation retained until explicit caller completion or uncertainty; never automatically replay

EVENT.rule: ordered reliable occurrence in the session; no durable event store or inferred current state

BULK.rule: bounded streaming SHA-256; synchronous caller staging sink; commit only after exact total and final digest; no automatic resume

EPHEMERAL.rule: no ACK or recovery expectation; explicit queued/dropped result, local write errors remain observable

stateOwner.constraints: NoChange requires exact confirmed token; Delta base must equal confirmed token; unknown/old token requires an owner-provided Snapshot, not inferred fallback; owner must honor cancellation

cursor: bounded volatile subscription metadata: lastSent, lastConfirmed, received. Revisions are opaque; only known message sequence order prevents delayed ACK regression
restart: same-process explicit reconnect retains LogicalSession/cursors; new process creates a new session and obtains owner snapshot; no Crowsi durable journal
resources: foundation writer budget plus separate realtime correlation budget, each <=4 frames; max 16 owner recovery requests, one per subscription; receiver holds digest/order only, never full bulk contents; synchronous application callbacks own their materialization resources
bulkDuplicate: only exact immediately preceding chunk duplicate accepted without writing twice; older/missing/changed chunks rejected; no completed-transfer replay store; uncertain transfer restarts only at explicit owner request with a fresh transfer identity
bulkTimeout: sender completion rejects BulkIncomplete and releases transfer; receiver aborts staging and reports BulkIncomplete once on idle timeout/disconnect; other reliable classes are not silently dropped
